findings.evidence: Live can_access_module/list_accessible_modules return ready=true and default entitlement=true; business_entitlements.features is empty for 7 live businesses.
Live paystack-initialize writes to absent payments_paystack table while live verification/webhook use payment_transactions.
paystack-initialize does not authorize invoice_id against caller membership and accepts caller-supplied business_id in direct mode.
Rich meeting backend exists, but recording is local-stream based, capture processing remains pending, signed URL semantics are defective, and transcribe-audio is absent live.
CRM deals are local React state; durable persistence is not implemented.
createEntry persists only journal header; journal lines are not persisted and reports use opening balances.
execute-automation and due cron exist, but live automations and automation_runs are both zero.
campaign-send and email-service are live, but campaign status can become sent from HTTP success even when individual sends fail; recipient selection is not campaign-specific.
Secure dispatch function is live, but displayed callable endpoint and end-to-end delivery are not certified.
ask-avenize is live, authenticated and grounded in business context, but implementation is deterministic native reasoning and action execution is not fully certified.
Search UI exists, but result routing is incomplete and indexing/tenant-scoping is not fully certified.
RFQ/PO UI exists without a proven supplier-to-PO lifecycle.
Supabase CRUD and activity logging are real; broader assignment/review/time/automation loop remains unproven.
Event CRUD is real; attendee/invitation/reminder collaboration chain is not certified.
Manifest/icons prove installability configuration only, not mobile business workflows.

next_gate: Complete route/tool inventory and convert every high-value capability into executable operational E2E contracts before repair certification.
